reason: A testing and debugging plugin that runs test commands and parses Jest, Vitest, Pytest, Go, Rust, TAP, and TypeScript failure output into structured reports.

summaries.zh: 用于运行测试命令并解析多种测试框架及 TypeScript 编译失败输出的测试调试插件。
summaries.en: A testing and debugging plugin that runs test commands and parses failures from multiple test runners and TypeScript compilation.

capabilities: Runs user-specified test commands through a subprocess interface
Parses test and TypeScript compiler output into structured failure reports
Supports multiple test runners and failure formats
